scope: Post-hoc TRAIN-only mechanism diagnosis; no production cutover or reserved-split scoring
pole_recovery: Closest estimated frequency within 5% of true critical frequency AND alpha error <= max(1/s, 10% of absolute true alpha); report continuous errors too. Truth is evaluation-only, evaluated at window end.
waveform_detector: Causal 20-sample first-difference energy mean > 4 times immediately preceding 100-sample energy mean; rising edges with 100ms refractory interval; score against command onset with 0..50ms delay. Fixed rule, no label tuning.
frozen: Cap 50, actual leading-prefix calibration, original predictors, policy thresholds, and original partitions unchanged. Changed-aperture features never enter the margin model. New estimator variants are diagnostic only; no latency qualification.
temporal_prerequisite: Do not train schedule-confounded GRU on these eight traces. First require recoverable physical poles and nontrivial pre-crossing coverage under noise; then one design-grouped randomized-schedule matched framewise/GRU/time-only experiment.
limitations: Synthetic noise levels, actuator log availability, physical harmful-amplitude threshold, sensor/communication latency, and deployment specifications are not measured here. Additional designs selected before results. No inference-time simulator truth.
